what: Behind the section, full-bleed photo layers, stacked as many as there are cards, stay stuck to the screen while white vertical cards in the center pass in front of them. From the second card on, its own photo switches on over .2s when the card’s top touches the screen center, so the background photo changes per card, and the photo is pushed 10lvh late while its card passes. The first card enters with its top cut off (.6 — 60% of the screen) and opens, and the last card folds closed with its bottom down to 75lvh. At the section start and end it shrinks by twice the margin and expands again, with corners rounded 6px. Below 1024px, photos and cards stack in turn

options.drift: Share by which the photo is pushed late (lvh), default 10
options.open: Share of the first card cropped at start, default .6
options.fold: Height at which the end card folds (lvh), default 75
options.margin: Margin that shrinks at head and end (px), default 20
options.narrow: Stack only at or below this width (px), default 1024
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Back photo layer — cards in order, one photo inside

note: The original pins the photo layer by moving it down by ScrollTrigger progress × length (same effect as sticky — this part uses the same method so it doesn’t break in inner scroll panels either)

from.where: index.html service stage (original p-service: photo swap .2 · --i1·--i2·--i3 · clip-path inset((.6−i1)×60lvh) · inset(0 0 i3×75lvh))
